guardrails: A task-profile-incompatible triple is not automatically described as invalid STIX.
Project relation labels are canonicalized only for compatibility checks and reporting; training labels are not rewritten.
file-paths, sha256s, and tactic are endpoint-unresolved/pass-through in v1.
Profile rules are derived from the OASIS STIX 2.1 relationship summary and training-side audit evidence only; validation/test labels do not create or revise rules.
